comment: Licence gate (decision 0007), enforced by tools/licencecheck. 'allowed' is the linked-or-bundled tier: a licence allowed for every ecosystem, or an object limiting it to some (go, npm, vendored). Each exception names one Go module, npm package or vendored directory, its ecosystem, its licence, and why it is acceptable. 'vendored' lists every directory holding code copied into the repository, with the licences it is under that its licence files do not show. Adding an allowed licence or an exception needs a decision-log entry or founder approval.

@fontsource-variable/inter.reason: The console's typeface (Inter), bundled as font files only, unmodified; approved by the founder on 2026-10-08. The SIL Open Font License allows bundling fonts with any software, places no terms on that software, and only requires the fonts keep their licence and are not sold on their own.

@fontsource-variable/plus-jakarta-sans.reason: The public website's typeface (Plus Jakarta Sans), the same basis as the Inter exception: font files only, unmodified, served with their licence. The SIL Open Font License allows bundling fonts with any software, places no terms on that software, and only requires the fonts keep their licence and are not sold on their own. Added with the website (PR 53, 2026-10-21) under the decision to self-host the designer's fonts.

@fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono.reason: The public website's monospace typeface (JetBrains Mono), the same basis as the Inter exception: font files only, unmodified, served with their licence. The SIL Open Font License allows bundling fonts with any software, places no terms on that software, and only requires the fonts keep their licence and are not sold on their own. Added with the website (PR 53, 2026-10-21) under the decision to self-host the designer's fonts.

axe-core.reason: Dev-only: accessibility checks in browser tests; never bundled. MPL-2.0 is file-level copyleft and the code runs unmodified at test time. Approved by the founder on 2026-10-08.

lightningcss.reason: Dev-only: CSS tooling pulled in by vite/vitest. Runs at build/test time, unmodified; none of its code is bundled into shipped artefacts. MPL-2.0 is file-level copyleft. Revisit if it ever becomes a runtime dependency.

engine/sandbox/pywasm.reason: CPython 3.12 built for WebAssembly (PROVENANCE.md), embedded in the binary for code steps. The build is Apache-2.0; CPython is under the PSF licence (Python-2.0), allowed for this module by decision 0056; its notice ships as LICENSE-CPython.

tools/docsite/assets/fonts.reason: The public website's typefaces (Plus Jakarta Sans, JetBrains Mono), self-hosted as font files, unmodified, with their licences: the same fonts and basis as the npm @fontsource-variable exceptions (PR 53, 2026-10-21). Material Symbols, in the same directory, is Apache-2.0.

engine/sandbox/pywasm.reason: CPython for WebAssembly, taken unmodified from @antonz/python-wasi@3.12.0 (PROVENANCE.md). LICENSE covers the build (Apache-2.0); LICENSE-CPython is CPython 3.12.0's own licence (PSF, Python-2.0), allowed by decision 0056.

third_party/qjs.reason: Taskiem's fork of github.com/fastschema/qjs v0.0.6 (MIT), the code-step JavaScript sandbox (decision 0011, FORK.md); a Go module of its own, so the Go check also sees it.

tools/docsite/assets/fonts.reason: The public website's font files, self-hosted (docs/strategy/website.md).
